# Fall Just Got a New Address: Your Guide to Autumn in Waxhaw


Festivals, farmers markets, and a five-minute walk to all of it.


Tri Pointe Homes


•


August 20, 2026


Share this article


There's a very specific kind of magic that happens in Waxhaw once September hits. The porch lights flip on a little earlier. Main Street starts smelling like kettle corn and firewood. And somehow, every single person in town suddenly owns a flannel. If you've never spent a fall season here, buckle up — because **Old Town Village** puts you close enough to walk to almost all of it.


Here's what's on the calendar, why you'll want a front-row seat, and why the address you're standing in matters just as much as the season itself.


---


## First, a Little About Where You'd Be Standing


[Old Town Village](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/charlotte/old-town-village) · Waxhaw, NC


> *Old Town Village is a walkable new home community tucked right into downtown Waxhaw*


The kind of place where "I'll walk over" is a real sentence you get to say, not a stretch goal. Homes here are designed for real life: first-floor bedrooms and flexible spaces for guests or multigenerational living, gourmet kitchens with the kind of finishes that make hosting effortless, and covered outdoor living spaces built for exactly the kind of crisp fall evening you're picturing right now.


Our move-in ready homes are thoughtfully curated by the Tri Pointe Design Studio, so the details — cabinetry, hardware, finishes — feel intentional instead of generic. And because this is downtown Waxhaw, "new construction" doesn't mean "out past everything." It means walkable to Main Street, minutes from festival season, and genuinely part of the town instead of adjacent to it.


---


## 🎪 Waxhaw Harvest & Hops Fest | September 12


> Museum of The Waxhaws |[Explore More](https://www.eventeny.com/events/waxhaw-fall-festsept-12th-30437/?srsltid=AfmBOopQdxzpGcQQSAL74o8zvkOK20XyKJFwma0MBK6Xc5HhRjsnHz1C)


Kicking things off is the Waxhaw Fall Fest at the Museum of the Waxhaws, running 11am to 6pm. Think food trucks lined up in every direction, local vendors selling the kind of handmade goods you didn't know you needed, a lineup of breweries and vineyards for the grown-ups, and enough kids' activities to buy yourself a full plate of nachos in peace. It's the kind of low-key Saturday that turns into an all-day hang without anyone planning it that way.


---


## 🍂 Autumn Treasures | October 10


> Downtown Waxhaw, NC |[Explore More](https://www.waxhaw.com/our-town/events/autumn-treasures)


If Waxhaw throws one party all year that you do not miss, it's this one. Autumn Treasures is the town's biggest annual festival, taking over downtown Waxhaw and Downtown Park for a full day of artisan vendors, live music on every block, a kids' zone, and a BBQ contest that gets more competitive than it has any right to be. Streets close, Main Street fills up, and for one Saturday, downtown Waxhaw basically becomes a block party with really good pulled pork.


---


## 🥕 Waxhaw Farmers Market | Every Saturday Through December


> 27283 Waxhaw Pkwy, Waxhaw, NC |[Explore More](https://www.waxhawfarmersmarket.org/)


Not a festival, but the kind of weekly ritual that quietly becomes your favorite part of the weekend. Every Saturday morning from 9am to noon, local farmers, bakers, and makers set up shop — fresh produce, local meat, honey, soap, live music, and the kind of small talk with strangers that only happens at a farmers market. It runs all the way through December, so this isn't a one-and-done — it's basically a season-long standing date with your neighbors.


---


## So... how close is "close," exactly?


Close enough that "should we drive?" isn't really a question. From Old Town Village Rd:


-


**N Main St, Downtown Waxhaw (Autumn Treasures HQ):** about a quarter mile — a five-minute stroll, porch to parade


-


**Waxhaw Pkwy (Waxhaw Farmers Market):** under half a mile — an easy walk, or a two-minute drive if you're running late


-


**Waxhaw Hwy (Museum of the Waxhaws, Fall Fest):** under a mile — a quick walk or a three-minute drive


Basically: park the car, grab a jacket, and go. This is what "walkable to downtown Waxhaw" actually looks like in practice.


---
